alpha_hypothesis.statement: Some poor live exit outcomes may be caused by explicit targets being hidden behind the legacy_basis guard rather than by weak ticker alpha.

promotion_requirements: move SIGNAL_TARGET legacy override into shared position_manager policy
keep avg_cost profit ladder disabled for legacy_basis
add focused tests for legacy_basis + explicit target hit
confirm canonical fixed-window backtest metrics do not move unless a full lifecycle replay is explicitly promoted
gate.success_condition: at least one saved production day shows suppressed explicit target

historical_experiment_check.anti_repeat: Not exp-20260429-032. This run does not convert target_price to a 33% partial reduce in backtest and does not alter canonical exits.
historical_experiment_check.related_failure: exp-20260429-032 rejected bare SIGNAL_TARGET partial-reduce replay after EV and PnL regressed in all three windows.

hypothesis: Explicit strategy target_price should remain actionable even when a position is marked legacy_basis; legacy_basis should suppress only avg_cost-anchored profit ladders, not an explicit recorded target.
next_retry_requires: If promoted, implement the narrow shared policy change in position_manager.evaluate_exit_signals.
Do not implement a partial-reduce replay by itself; exp-20260429-032 already rejected that path.
Separate intent-aware action semantics from the legacy guard fix if full EXIT vs REDUCE needs optimization.

parameters.baseline_behavior: evaluate_exit_signals requires not legacy_basis before SIGNAL_TARGET
parameters.shadow_variant: allow explicit signal_target_price to surface despite legacy_basis
parameters.treatment_definition: operator position has target_price; saved daily trend signal has daily_high or close >= target; position_context.legacy_basis is true; current baseline exit_signals do not include SIGNAL_TARGET
